title: Architecture decision
description: The front matter of an architecture decision under .ai/repo/adrs/: an identity that fixes the file name, the lifecycle status, the date it reached that status, the decisions it stands in for, and where it came from. The body carries the narrative (# Context, # Decision, # Consequences, and optionally # Alternatives rejected). Every field here is read by `majordomus adr`, by the adr-integrity doctrine, or by both; none is decoration.

schema.description: The format version of this record. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

id.description: The identity, adr-NNNN, allocated once and never reused. It fixes the file name prefix and survives a retitle.

title.description: One line, the decision itself rather than the topic.

status.description: proposed: written by a machine or a person and not yet accepted. accepted: in force. superseded: replaced by the decision named in superseded_by. rejected: considered and refused, kept because the reasoning is worth reading.

date.description: The day the record reached its current status, YYYY-MM-DD.

supersedes.description: The decisions this one stands in for. Each must resolve to a record here, and that record must name this one in superseded_by.

superseded_by.description: The decision that replaced this one. Present exactly when the status is superseded.

provenance.description: Where the record came from. A record with origin `extracted` was proposed by the tool from a durable local record and may not be `accepted` in the same act that created it.

origin.description: authored: a person wrote it. extracted: `majordomus adr propose` derived it from a local record, which derived_from names.

derived_from.description: Typed references to what the record was derived from: `decision:<task-id>`, `session:<id>`, `commit:<sha>`, `issue:<id>`, `file:<repository-relative path>`, `test:<repository-relative path>`. The reference type is validated; a file or test reference must resolve.
